overview.title: The town’s postcard icon
overview.p1: The Stone Lion sits right in the centre of Ifrane and appears in countless photos of the town. It is a brief stop rather than a full walk — ideal upon arrival or before heading out to the lakes and cedar forests.
overview.p2: Pair it with a café stop in the centre and a stroll past the chalets that earned Ifrane its nickname, 'Little Switzerland'.

faq.title: Questions about the Stone Lion of Ifrane

q1.question: Is it worth a special visit?
q1.answer: Yes, as part of a town stroll — though it is not a half-day attraction on its own.

q2.question: How old is the lion?
q2.answer: It is a modern landmark tied to the identity of the Ifrane mountain resort.

q3.question: Is entry free?
q3.answer: Yes — it is an open-air public landmark.

q4.question: Is it good for kids?
q4.answer: Yes — quick, accessible, and right in the centre.

q5.question: Is it far from the lakes?
q5.answer: The lakes require a short drive; the lion is right in town.
